import os
import sys

executable, allow_online_models = sys.argv[1:]
if allow_online_models == "false":
    # Gazebo Classic otherwise waits for the remote model database while its
    # GUI remains on the "Preparing your world" splash screen. A closed local
    # endpoint makes missing local assets fail immediately and deterministically.
    os.environ["GAZEBO_MODEL_DATABASE_URI"] = "http://127.0.0.1:9"
elif allow_online_models == "true":
    os.environ.pop("GAZEBO_MODEL_DATABASE_URI", None)
else:
    raise SystemExit("allowOnlineModels must be true or false")
os.execv(executable, [executable])

import hashlib
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

executable, rosparam, ros_paths_plugin, ros_api_plugin, scene_plugin, world, physics, ros_log_dir, override_timing, max_step_size, real_time_update_rate, paused, verbose, allow_online = sys.argv[1:]
subprocess.run([rosparam, "set", "/use_sim_time", "true"], check=True)
subprocess.run([rosparam, "set", "/gazebo/enable_ros_network", "true"], check=True)
if allow_online.lower() != "true":
    os.environ["GAZEBO_MODEL_DATABASE_URI"] = "http://127.0.0.1:9"

if override_timing.lower() == "true":
    step = float(max_step_size)
    update_rate = float(real_time_update_rate)
    if step <= 0:
        raise SystemExit("maxStepSize must be greater than zero when world physics timing is overridden")
    if update_rate < 0:
        raise SystemExit("realTimeUpdateRate must be non-negative when world physics timing is overridden")

    with open(world, "rb") as source:
        source_bytes = source.read()
    digest = hashlib.sha256(b"xgc2-physics-timing-v1\0" + source_bytes + b"\0" + physics.encode() + b"\0" + max_step_size.encode() + b"\0" + real_time_update_rate.encode()).hexdigest()
    override_dir = os.path.join(ros_log_dir, "gazebo-world-overrides")
    os.makedirs(override_dir, exist_ok=True)
    override_world = os.path.join(override_dir, digest + ".world")
    if not os.path.exists(override_world):
        root = ET.fromstring(source_bytes)
        local_name = lambda element: element.tag.rsplit("}", 1)[-1]
        world_element = root if local_name(root) == "world" else next((element for element in root.iter() if local_name(element) == "world"), None)
        if world_element is None:
            raise SystemExit("Gazebo world file does not contain a world element")
        physics_element = next((element for element in world_element if local_name(element) == "physics"), None)
        namespace = world_element.tag[:-len(local_name(world_element))]
        if physics_element is None:
            physics_element = ET.SubElement(world_element, namespace + "physics", {"type": physics})
        physics_namespace = physics_element.tag[:-len(local_name(physics_element))]
        def set_physics_value(name, value):
            element = next((child for child in physics_element if local_name(child) == name), None)
            if element is None:
                element = ET.SubElement(physics_element, physics_namespace + name)
            element.text = value
        set_physics_value("max_step_size", max_step_size)
        set_physics_value("real_time_update_rate", real_time_update_rate)

        descriptor, temporary_world = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".world-", suffix=".tmp", dir=override_dir)
        os.close(descriptor)
        try:
            ET.ElementTree(root).write(temporary_world, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=True)
            os.chmod(temporary_world, 0o644)
            os.replace(temporary_world, override_world)
        finally:
            if os.path.exists(temporary_world):
                os.unlink(temporary_world)
    source_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.realpath(world))
    resource_path = os.environ.get("GAZEBO_RESOURCE_PATH", "")
    os.environ["GAZEBO_RESOURCE_PATH"] = source_dir + (os.pathsep + resource_path if resource_path else "")
    world = override_world
elif override_timing.lower() != "false":
    raise SystemExit("overrideWorldPhysicsTiming must be true or false")

arguments = [executable, "-e", physics,
             "-s", ros_paths_plugin,
             "-s", ros_api_plugin]
if scene_plugin:
    if not os.path.isabs(scene_plugin):
        raise SystemExit("Gazebo Scene plugin path is not absolute: " + scene_plugin)
    if os.path.isfile(scene_plugin):
        arguments.extend(["-s", scene_plugin])
    elif scene_plugin == "/opt/ros/noetic/lib/libxgc2_gazebo_scene_system.so":
        print("Recommended Gazebo Scene plugin is not installed; starting without it", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
    else:
        raise SystemExit("Gazebo Scene plugin is not a regular file: " + scene_plugin)
if paused.lower() == "true":
    arguments.append("-u")
if verbose.lower() == "true":
    arguments.append("--verbose")
arguments.extend([world, "__name:=gazebo"])
os.execv(executable, arguments)

import os
import sys

preferred_prefix, runtime_root, state_root, model_name, instance, parameter_file, *runner_args = sys.argv[1:]
prefixes = []
for prefix in (preferred_prefix, os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), ".local", "xgc2", "ros", "noetic"), "/opt/ros/noetic"):
    if prefix and prefix not in prefixes:
        prefixes.append(prefix)
runner = next((os.path.join(prefix, "lib", "gazebo_sim_px4_1_12", "run_px4_sitl.sh") for prefix in prefixes
               if os.access(os.path.join(prefix, "lib", "gazebo_sim_px4_1_12", "run_px4_sitl.sh"), os.X_OK)), "")
if not runner:
    raise SystemExit("run_px4_sitl.sh is not installed in the configured ROS prefix or the user overlay")
if not os.path.isfile(parameter_file):
    raise SystemExit("FS150 PX4 parameter file is missing: " + parameter_file)
work_dir = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser(state_root), model_name)
argv = [runner, "--runtime-root", runtime_root, "--work-dir", work_dir, "--instance", instance,
        "--script", "etc/init.d-posix/rcS", "--param-file", parameter_file, "--reset-params", "--"] + runner_args
os.execv(runner, argv)

import os
import subprocess
import sys

executable, namespace, node_name, config_files, *settings = sys.argv[1:]
namespace = namespace.strip("/")
if not node_name:
    raise SystemExit("ROS node name is required")
private_namespace = "/" + "/".join(filter(None, (namespace, node_name)))
rosparam = "/opt/ros/noetic/bin/rosparam"
subprocess.run([rosparam, "delete", private_namespace], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
for config_file in filter(None, config_files.split(",")):
    subprocess.run([rosparam, "load", config_file, private_namespace], check=True)
for setting in settings:
    key, separator, value = setting.partition("=")
    if not separator or not key:
        raise SystemExit("invalid trusted ROS parameter setting " + repr(setting))
    subprocess.run([rosparam, "set", private_namespace + "/" + key, value], check=True)
arguments = [executable, "__name:=" + node_name]
if namespace:
    arguments.append("__ns:=/" + namespace)
os.execv(executable, arguments)

import rospy,sys; from mavros_msgs.msg import State; rospy.init_node("xgc_mavros_connection_probe",anonymous=True,disable_signals=True); message=rospy.wait_for_message(sys.argv[1],State,timeout=3.0); raise SystemExit(0 if message.connected else 1)

import rospy,sys; from mavros_msgs.msg import State; rospy.init_node("xgc_mavros_connection_probe",anonymous=True,disable_signals=True); message=rospy.wait_for_message(sys.argv[1],State,timeout=3.0); raise SystemExit(0 if message.connected else 1)

mode="strict"
try:
    rosservice,model,raw_port,mode=sys.argv[1:]
    if mode not in ("strict","best-effort"):
        raise ValueError("invalid Gazebo cleanup mode: "+mode)
    uid=os.getuid()
    port=int(raw_port)
    lock_path=f"/tmp/xgc2-gazebo-delete-model-u{uid}-ros-p{port}.lock"
    fd=os.open(lock_path,os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_CLOEXEC,0o600)
    try:
        info=os.fstat(fd)
        if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_uid != uid:
            raise PermissionError(f"unsafe Gazebo delete-model lock: {lock_path}")
        fcntl.flock(fd,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        try:
            result=subprocess.run([rosservice,"call","/gazebo/delete_model",json.dumps({"model_name":model},separators=(",",":"))],timeout=4,check=False)
        finally:
            fcntl.flock(fd,fcntl.LOCK_UN)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise subprocess.CalledProcessError(result.returncode,result.args)
except BaseException:
    if mode == "best-effort":
        raise SystemExit(0)
    raise
